reasons.persona_fit: Directly addresses a small business owner-operator in Bareni's calm, practical voice, respects human-in-the-loop boundaries, and complies with the no-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: Logical, clean progression from identifying a single operational signal to evaluating repeatability before considering automation.
reasons.actionability: Gives a concrete, low-risk test step (manually logging one metric for two weeks) and a clear decision rule before building any tooling.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no fabricated customer, deployment, metric, or capability claims, cleanly framing automation applicability around repeatable tasks.
